exposure: Declared after reproduction_v1 effects; explicitly post-analysis, before these sensitivity computations.
motivation: MYRF/TBX5 directions repeat, fibroblast immune-context genes differ, and AT2-s has sparse donor/region coverage. Resolve technical and comparator alternatives before deriving RQs.

branches.B1: Report fixed 10/20/30/50-cell floors and leave-one-donor-out means without changing the primary 20-cell gate.
branches.B2: Pair assay directions within the same donor and anatomical region at the 10-cell sensitivity floor. Two assays of one donor are technical corroboration, not new replication.
branches.B3: Compute the exact expected detection probability under a without-replacement draw of 1000 molecules from each eligible 10x cell. Exclude cells with fewer than 1000 curated UMIs. Compare donor/region expected detection differences with observed differences. Do not apply this UMI diagnostic to SS2 reads.
branches.B4: Evaluate MYRF in AT1 versus AT2, Club, and other epithelial cells; TBX5 in pericytes versus alveolar fibroblasts, vascular smooth muscle and other stromal cells. Source annotation remains fixed and exposed.

decision_rules: No new significance or equivalence threshold; report effect directions, ranges and coverage.
Retain a bounded candidate only with its observed unit count, exposure and strongest rival.
Do not select genes or donors by significance or favorable effect direction.
Map candidate questions to existing A4/A8/A13/A22 when their core uncertainty overlaps; do not allocate a new global ID from the stale local register.
